title: The docs-only review path refuses a record that files an owner ruling
why: Decision docs-only-prs-skip-review says a record that files an owner ruling is never docs-only. The merge tool cannot tell such a record from other docs, and no check on main enforces it.
note: Coordinator (13:06 CST Nov 9), note ruling-record-docs-only from #2452 (step docs-only-record-checks-diff). Fix: a marker line in a ruling record, which the docs-only path refuses.
